EXPLANATORY NOTE
This Form 40-F/A is being filed to amend the Annual Report on Form 40-F for the year ended December 31, 2024, originally filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “Commission”) on March 13, 2025 (the “Original 40-F”). The purpose of this Form 40-F/A is to correct a hyperlink for the Exhibit 99.6 filed with the Original 40-F. The corrected hyperlink is included in this Form 40-F/A. Other than as discussed above, all information in the Registrant’s Original 40-F is unchanged.
